text: Hi! What time does the keynote start tomorrow, and is it in the big room?

Is there a vegan option at lunch? I didn't see anything labelled.
I was charged twice for my ticket. This is the third time I'm writing and nobody answers. I want a refund today or I'm disputing it with my bank.
Someone just fainted near the coffee stand on level 2. Several people are with her but we need medical help now.
The wifi password on the badge doesn't work for me. Is there another network?
Could you move my Thursday talk to a bigger room? The schedule shows 250 people interested and the room seats 80.
Lost my badge somewhere in hall B. Can I get a replacement at registration?
Great talk on virtual threads this morning, thank you! Will the slides be shared?
There's water leaking from the ceiling right above the power strips in room 4. People are still charging laptops there.
Our booth monitor keeps turning off, probably the power. Not urgent, but can someone look before the afternoon break?
The coffee is cold AGAIN and the queue is 20 minutes long. Honestly this is ridiculous for a conference this expensive.
Where can I pick up my conference t-shirt? I ordered size M.
My co-speaker's flight got cancelled. Can I still give our talk alone at 14:00, and can you update the schedule?

Can I switch my 3-day pass to a different name? My colleague is coming instead of me tomorrow.
The fire exit door on the ground floor near the cloakroom is chained shut.
Thanks for organising such a smooth speaker dinner yesterday!
I have a severe nut allergy and just realised the dessert I ate might have had nuts. I feel my throat getting tight.

Just wanted to say the new badge scanning at the door is super fast. Nice job.
